name: Jotunheimstien
description_md:
Jotunheimstien is a waymarked hiking route in Norway covering a distance of 330.6 km. The route involves 8223 m of ascent and 7235 m of descent.

This hard route takes about 104 hours on the DIN 33466 hiking time rule, with difficulty derived from distance and ascent. It belongs to the national waymarked hiking network, and the line matches the official route published by turrutebasen. Walkers will find that the route passes National Gallery within 1000 m and Akershus castle within 1400 m.
